claim_checks.claim: Organic growth trend 2023-26 / 'organic growth back to +5-6%'
claim_checks.finding: Comparable-unit growth: 2023 +6%, 2024 -1%, 2025 -2%, 9M 2026 +3% (Q3 2026 +5%). The +5-6% figure is a single quarter (Q3-26 sales +5%, order intake +6%), not the YTD run-rate (+3%). Two consecutive years of organic decline (2024-25) preceded the recovery.

claim_checks.finding: FY2025 actual: Sweden 22% (not ~26%), UK & Ireland 12%, Benelux 10%, Denmark 9%, Finland 8%, Norway 7%, Germany 6%, North America 5%, Asia 4%.
